notificationAcceptanceLaw.acceptWhen: documentId and planRevision equal the installed view target, commandRequestId equals the latest, generation greater than accepted, or equal generation with strictly greater notificationSequence

cases.subject: initial render never shows playing
cases.given: the studio loads with a demo chart and no accepted transport notification
cases.expected: badge renders 'Audio unavailable' or 'Ready' with generation 0; never 'Playing'; scrub slider disabled with no-bound-plan until a plan binds

cases.subject: unavailable badge
cases.given: accepted TransportViewState with status unavailable and no failureCode
cases.expected: badge 'Audio off', detail carries the actionable locked/engine-unavailable reason, Play disabled with audio-unavailable

cases.subject: ready badge
cases.given: accepted status ready with a bound plan
cases.expected: badge 'Audio ready', detail names the bound plan or the empty-transport hint; Play and Restart enabled

cases.subject: starting badge
cases.given: expect-transport optimism installed status starting
cases.expected: badge 'Starting playback' with no detail; all transport controls disabled with status-settling

cases.subject: playing badge
cases.given: accepted status playing
cases.expected: badge 'Playing', detail carries the current chord label and exact Bar·beat; Pause/Stop/Restart enabled, Play disabled with not-running

cases.subject: ordinary paused badge
cases.given: accepted status paused with null failureCode
cases.expected: badge 'Paused', detail carries the paused-at exact beat; Stop and Restart remain enabled

cases.subject: interrupted presentation
cases.given: accepted status paused with failureCode transport.interrupted
cases.expected: badge 'Interrupted', detail states resume requires a trusted gesture and offers the Resume action; distinct from ordinary Paused

cases.subject: stopping badge
cases.given: expect-transport optimism installed status stopping
cases.expected: badge 'Stopping playback' with no detail; controls disabled with status-settling

cases.subject: fault badge with recovery
cases.given: accepted status failed with a stable failure code
cases.expected: badge 'Audio failed', detail carries the stable code and offers reinitialize-audio; chart editing and export remain fully interactive

cases.subject: older generation cannot repaint
cases.given: accepted generation 9 sequence 40; a notification arrives with generation 8 sequence 99
cases.expected: A0 rejects as ignored-stale; badge, scrubber, and now block render the generation-9 state unchanged

cases.subject: same generation older sequence cannot repaint
cases.given: accepted generation 9 sequence 40; a notification arrives with generation 9 sequence 40
cases.expected: rejected as ignored-stale (sequence must be strictly greater); no repaint

cases.subject: wrong document identity cannot repaint
cases.given: a notification whose documentId differs from the installed view target
cases.expected: rejected as ignored-stale; no repaint

cases.subject: wrong plan revision cannot repaint
cases.given: a notification whose planRevision differs from the installed document revision
cases.expected: rejected as ignored-stale; no repaint

cases.subject: wrong command request cannot repaint
cases.given: a notification whose commandRequestId is not the latest
cases.expected: rejected as ignored-stale; no repaint

cases.subject: the eight-step run projects in order
cases.given: the X1 browser-matrix run: initialize, play, natural end replay, pause, resume, preview, release, stop
cases.expected: the badge sequence is Audio ready, Playing, Audio ready, Playing, Paused, Playing, Audio ready with strictly increasing notificationSequence; stop's last frame shows the playhead at the run startBeat

cases.subject: instrument change while playing
cases.given: an instrument-change intent settles while a run is playing
cases.expected: the status detail shows the transient statement 'Takes effect at the next unstarted note' until the next accepted notification

cases.subject: instrument change while stopped
cases.given: an instrument-change intent settles while ready or paused
cases.expected: the persistent hint 'Applies to the next Play.' shows until the next play begins

cases.subject: instrument change while audio is down
cases.given: an instrument-change attempt while unavailable or failed
cases.expected: pre-dispatch refusal audio-unavailable; the picker shows the unchanged value; no boundary notice appears

cases.subject: document replacement clears the boundary notice
cases.given: a boundary notice is showing when replace-plan settles
cases.expected: the notice is gone in the next render; a stale notice never names an instrument boundary after replacement

cases.subject: the display sweep writes nothing back
cases.given: the animation-frame sweep polls the display playhead while playing
cases.expected: no application state, notification, or transport command results; committed playhead changes arrive only via accepted notifications

cases.subject: refused command settles optimism exactly
cases.given: a play intent whose X1 command refuses (for example a plan mismatch)
cases.expected: the expectation settles via settle-transport-expectation with the echoed actual state and the stable refusal code; the badge never parks at starting

cases.subject: superseded expectation settles as ready
cases.given: a still-optimistic expectation whose plan was superseded by replacement
cases.expected: settlement carries cause transport.plan_superseded and the badge returns to the truthful state; no stale playhead frame

cases.subject: count-in toggle renders no optimism
cases.given: a count-in toggle intent whose X1 command refuses
cases.expected: the toggle renders the selector's unchanged effective state after the refusal; no local optimistic flip persists

cases.subject: every X1 refusal code has a detail rendering
cases.given: the frozen TRANSPORT_REFUSAL_CODES union
cases.expected: the detail layer renders a stable, non-chart-text message for every code, including count_in and metronome refusals; unknown codes render the generic fault detail
